long: Outer Wilds Alpha 1.2 is an early prototype build of the acclaimed space-exploration adventure. The player explores a small handcrafted solar system trapped in a time loop, uncovering the secrets of an ancient civilization. This alpha showcases the core open-world exploration and physics-driven planetary systems before the full release.
name: Outer Wilds Alpha 1.2
short: Outer Wilds Alpha 1.2 (via Proton and gamescope)
